gate-number.purpose: The fit score, monumental like an airport gate number.

flap.purpose: Departures board (application lists) only: mono caps, wide tracking.

motion.name: flap
motion.purpose: Board status cell flips on change; staggered 45ms per row on first paint; none under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black plate, white bold label, forward actions trail an arrow.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Generate <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M4 12h15M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#0b0b0b;color:#fff;font:700 1rem "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;height:48px;padding:0 20px;border:0;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#1a1a1a}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0b0b0b;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White with a 2px black frame; Edit, Copy, Regenerate, Download.
components.css: .ds-btn-sec{background:#fff;color:#0b0b0b;font:700 .875rem "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:2px solid #0b0b0b;border-radius:3px}

components.name: Fit Sign
components.description: Yellow sign with black frame: gate-number score, verdict tally, summary.
components.html:
Fit for this role

1 match · 1 partial · 1 gap
components.css: .ds-sign{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:24px;background:#ffcc00;color:#0b0b0b;border:2px solid #0b0b0b;border-radius:6px;padding:24px;font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-sign .n{font-size:5rem;font-weight:800;line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.04em}.ds-sign small{font-size:1.1rem;color:#4a3b00}.ds-sign .r{border-left:2px solid #0b0b0b;padding-left:24px}

components.name: Departures Board Row
components.description: Black board row: time · role · fit · status in mono caps.

narrative.overview: An airport sign system for job applications: yellow sign bands and black pictogram squares answer 'where do I stand, what next' at a glance; long reading sits on white panels over concourse gray; past applications run on a split-flap departures board.
